- Output: `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener/18874.json`
- Trust decision: the bearer scope action is decided once, from the HTTP method, at `pkg/api/authn.go:607-616` (everything but GET/HEAD → push, so DELETE passes a push-only token); the fix adds DELETE → delete.
- `pattern_fit`: none — the fix is one hunk in one shared middleware, and every DELETE route (manifests, blobs, upload sessions) funnels through it, so no O2 site and no O8 route.
- Strongest lever: the coupled behaviour — DELETE of an upload session is push-scoped by the spec, and the claim vocabulary is pull/push/delete, so copying `authz.go:693-715`'s read/create/update/delete mapping silently breaks all bearer tokens.
- Biggest red flag: `single_site`; it is also a ~10-minute fix, so it should not host a task.
